report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with sub-350ms durations; logs show no errors and metrics show zero 502s. The alert's latency spike is not corroborated as a fault by current evidence, and no public cause (http-500, db-pool-exhaustion, redis-timeout, downstream-latency, memory-leak, bad-configuration) is established. Handing off rather than asserting an unsupported cause.
missing_evidence: Sustained latency or error evidence on /v1/checkout beyond the single 344ms sample
Dependency-level latency/error metrics for order, inventory, payment, redis, postgres
Baseline latency distribution to judge whether 344ms is anomalous
